subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should this PR introduce the public `sessions.activity`/`session.activity` and plugin task/tool hook contract now, or should those API surfaces wait for the canonical activity issue to define attention, stale-run, and child-rollup semantics?
rationale: The branch adds Gateway protocol and plugin SDK contracts, and current related issues show the activity semantics are still a product/API decision rather than a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Align Then Merge
options.body: Require the PR to match the maintainer-approved activity contract, fix session scoping, resolve conflicts, and add real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Defer Public Hooks
options.body: Let a narrower UI/session visibility subset proceed only if the plugin SDK and public protocol additions are removed until the canonical contract is settled.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it later if maintainers choose to define the full activity API in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 first.

recommendation.title: Align Then Merge
recommendation.body: Require the PR to match the maintainer-approved activity contract, fix session scoping, resolve conflicts, and add real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical activity-contract issue and has recent Gateway/protocol history in the affected area.
